cv_cover_letter_hint: A concise application letter based on the experience and skills presented in this CV.
cv_cover_letter_body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my interest in Senior Backend Developer opportunities within your organization. With approximately 11 years of professional software engineering experience, I have worked across Finance, Retail, FMCG, Employee Management, Project Management, Promotion Platforms, Virtual Commerce, and Embedded Software domains.

My core strength is backend engineering and enterprise application development, with hands-on experience in C#, ASP.NET Core, .NET Core, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, RESTful APIs, system integration, database optimization, and production support. I have also worked with software architecture practices including Clean Architecture, SOLID, CQRS, dependency injection, and layered application design.

Throughout my career, I have contributed to enterprise systems by developing backend services, integrating external systems, modernizing legacy applications, optimizing database workloads, resolving production issues, and translating business requirements into maintainable technical solutions. I value clean code, reliability, practical architecture, and effective collaboration across technical and business teams.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my backend engineering experience and enterprise software background could contribute to your team. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Thai Doan Son
Senior Backend Developer
doanson44@gmail.com
